mechanism: Sacubitril inhibits neprilysin leading to increased bradykinin and natriuretic peptides, while raloxifene increases thrombotic risk; combined use may elevate bleeding tendency and requires monitoring in patients on concurrent anticoagulation.
action: Monitor for signs of bleeding or thrombotic events; ensure appropriate anticoagulation management if patient requires both agents; consider alternative selective estrogen receptor modulator if bleeding risk becomes problematic.
